cues.text: On the beach, Mitsuru, Fuuka and Yukari stand together in their swimsuits: Mitsuru in a bikini with a flower at the shoulder and a long wrap skirt, Fuuka in a bikini top and a short skirt, Yukari in a bikini top and denim shorts.
The three of them chat among themselves, too quietly to hear. Junpei turns to you with a grin and walks over.
Junpei sprints off toward the sea.
Junpei splashes into the water. Akihiko races after him and splashes in too. You stand on the sand beside a float ring lying at your feet, the girls a little way behind you.
You walk off toward the water, leaving the float ring on the sand.
